name: Find Bingles
summary: In Ironforge, Gnoarn starts a search for Find Bingles after more than a week without word. Bingles Blastenheimer vanished during a flight toward fallen Gnomeregan, and searchers are sent to Loch Modan's shores. There, Bingles is alive and needs mechanical salvage.

sections.title: A Missing Pilot
sections.body: Gnome aviator Bingles Blastenheimer was sent from Tinker Town in Ironforge to scout the irradiated ruins of Gnomeregan from the air. More than a week has passed without word. Gnoarn fears Bingles may have blown himself out of the sky, a danger of gnome engineering. His last report placed him somewhere above Loch Modan's waters.

sections.title: Down at the Loch
sections.body: Searchers find Bingles alive along the Loch Modan shoreline, far from a tragic pile of wreckage. He is unfazed by his long absence and takes slight offense that anyone doubted his piloting. Rather than return promptly to report to Gnoarn, he asks his rescuer to recover tools and Blastencapper explosives stolen by troggs. He wants them so he can resume his duties for the gnomish movement.

faq.answer: Bingles Blastenheimer is an eccentric gnomish aviator and mechanic. He was sent to scout fallen Gnomeregan from the air, then crashed near Loch Modan.

faq.q: Why was Bingles flying over Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: After Gnomeregan fell to troggs and radiation, gnomish leaders and tinkerers kept watch over it. Bingles flew above the city to scout enemy positions and conditions as part of the effort to reclaim their home.
Bingles is along Loch Modan's southeastern shore, trying to sort out his downed flying machine.
Gnoarn is a gnome coordinator in Tinker Town, Ironforge. He tracks gnomish personnel and missions, and begins the search when Bingles fails to return on schedule.
After Bingles is found, adventurers can recover his wrench, screwdriver, hammer, and Blastencapper explosives from troggs on the Loch's islands.

faq.q: Is Bingles hurt from the crash?
faq.answer: Bingles is unharmed, though his pride is ruffled because Gnoarn doubted his flying skills. He is focused on recovering the tools and explosives the troggs stole from him.

angles.text: As a gnome, recovering Bingles helps sustain hope for retaking Gnomeregan, where every scout and flying machine counts.
As an engineer, you know the hazards of gnomish aviation, where a lost wing nut or an engine blast is part of field work.
As an Alliance scout, you help bridge the communications gap between Ironforge's halls and field operations across Loch Modan.
